name: Ganjapod
journalNotes: Sleeps 19 hours a day under palm trees. Smells like sweet nag champa and oregano.

name: Hashlump
journalNotes: Has not finished a sentence since the monsoon. Rolls downhill to get anywhere.

name: Charagolem
journalNotes: A hill that learned to sigh. Villages have been built on it by mistake.

name: Jawling
journalNotes: Has been explaining its startup idea by the generator since Tuesday. Do not make eye contact.

name: Gurnagama
journalNotes: Its jaw moves sideways faster than the eye can follow. Dentists weep.

name: Amphetadragon
journalNotes: Awake since Thursday. Certain that everyone is talking about it. They are now.

name: Blottertot
journalNotes: Folded out of bicycle paper. If you stare at its back, the UI starts breathing.

name: Fractoad
journalNotes: Every wart contains a smaller Fractoad. Researchers stopped counting at eleven.

name: Hoffmanite
journalNotes: A crystal frog that exists slightly to the left of itself. Answers questions you have not asked yet.

name: Crabcake
journalNotes: A sunburned tourist convinced he is a crustacean. Nobody has the heart to tell him.

name: Lobsterlad
journalNotes: Factor zero for nine days. The colour is now permanent and so is the walk.

name: Ketacrab
journalNotes: Walks exclusively sideways and upside down. Has never once arrived on purpose.

name: Wonkrab
journalNotes: Its claws are in a different postcode from its body. Both are fine with this.

name: Shroomba
journalNotes: A sentient clay pot of mushroom omelette. Sold at shacks that do not have a name.

name: Omeletron
journalNotes: Extra cheese, extra dimensions. The pot is now optional.

name: Djembe-Monk
journalNotes: The guy who plays bongos next to your tent at 7:30 AM, given form.

name: Bongo Bishop
journalNotes: Leads a drum circle that has not stopped since 2009. Nobody knows the original rhythm.

name: Shadowcop
journalNotes: A mirage of flashlight beams and whistle sounds. Probably not real. Hide everything anyway.

name: Bribe-asaurus
journalNotes: Grows a little with every small folded note. Has never issued a receipt.

name: Nitroxide
journalNotes: A metallic balloon with thirty glorious seconds to live. Makes them count.

name: Snoozel
journalNotes: Found wherever there is a beanbag. May or may not be a pile of laundry.

name: Duvetghast
journalNotes: A warm blanket with nobody under it. Five more minutes, it whispers. Five more years.

name: Tridog
journalNotes: A feral beach dog with a third eye. Knows who dropped the samosa. Knows everything.

name: Omnihound
journalNotes: Sees your past lives and judges every one of them. Still wants the samosa.

name: Glowkid
journalNotes: A lost raver made entirely of glowsticks. Has been looking for its friends since the first night.

name: Ravelord
journalNotes: Found its friends. They were inside it all along. So was the bassline.

name: Chillem
journalNotes: A clay golem with a smouldering head. Moves once per sunset.

name: Mozzquito
journalNotes: You hear it only when the music stops. The music never stops. It is still there.

name: Dengoth
journalNotes: Wears eyeliner. Drinks only from people who forgot their repellent.

name: Lassiblob
journalNotes: A banana lassi that was left in the sun and developed opinions.

name: Wooklet
journalNotes: Asks if you have a spare anything. Sleeps in a hammock made of other hammocks.

name: Grand Wook
journalNotes: Has not paid for a ticket since the nineties. Its dreadlocks have their own campsite.

name: Sirenowl
journalNotes: Its call sounds exactly like an approaching patrol. Entire dancefloors have emptied for nothing.

name: Neighbula
journalNotes: A horse-shaped cloud of calm. Riders report arriving somewhere else entirely, much later.

name: Selfiend
journalNotes: Feeds on golden-hour light. Will block a sunset for forty minutes to get the angle.

name: Mandalord
journalNotes: Sacred geometry that noticed it was being looked at. Seen once in the Sadhu Cave, if at all.

name: Sunraga
journalNotes: The sunset, finally off the clock. Only shows itself to people who stopped paying to look west.

name: Bassilisk
journalNotes: The bass under the Mainstage. You do not hear it. For a moment, you are it.

name: Vicchiomorph
journalNotes: The aliens of Vicchio. They follow the rave every year, a nonno in Tuscany swore it. Only lands at night, for people on the right frequency.

name: Mirrorling
journalNotes: A puddle of the sea that learned to stand up. It copies the first thing you do to it, and is a little smug about it. Only seen by people with nobody inside.

name: Lucidra
journalNotes: A jellyfish of light that drifts over Sweetwater Lake on the darkest nights. Its sting is a long, warm sleep. Only seen by people who have let go completely.

name: Betelbug
journalNotes: A beetle that chews betel nut all day and spits red at the road. The road was grey once.

name: Paanther
journalNotes: Wrapped in a betel leaf, pinned with a clove. Its smile is red and it has not slept since the wedding.

name: Lostling
journalNotes: Lost its friends, its phone and one shoe, in that order. Follows any torch that looks confident.

name: Wherewolf
journalNotes: Howls one question at the moon, all night: where is the camp. The moon has stopped answering.

name: Chaisloth
journalNotes: Nine glasses of chai a day and it still takes an hour to cross the tent. Its heart is doing all the running.

name: Hammockoon
journalNotes: Checked into a hammock in the dry season. The guesthouse has stopped asking when it is leaving.

name: Siestapir
journalNotes: Sleeps through the afternoon set on principle. The beach has been arranged around it.

name: Glimmoth
journalNotes: Circles every lamp in the wood as if it were the only one. It has been wrong about that all its life and is at peace with it.

name: Moonmoth
journalNotes: Stopped chasing lamps the night it found the moon. The dust from its wings makes people apologise to trees.

name: Echit
journalNotes: Says everything twice, the second time from somewhere else. Hangs where the canyon repeats itself.

name: Reverbat
journalNotes: Its squeak takes four bars to come back, and comes back wetter. Sound engineers leave it offerings.

name: Tweeterling
journalNotes: A chick hatched in a speaker stack. It only does the high notes, and it does them at six in the morning.

name: Woofhound
journalNotes: Barks in the mid range. Guards the cables, chews the cables, is sorry about the cables.

name: Subwoofang
journalNotes: You do not hear it growl, you feel it in your fillings. Three villages away, a noise complaint is being written.

name: Diyaling
journalNotes: A clay lamp somebody lit and forgot. It has kept itself going on ghee and stubbornness.

name: Aartiflame
journalNotes: Five flames on one brass plate, turning clockwise. Wave a hand over it and take the warmth, it does not mind.

name: Roadcalf
journalNotes: Sits down wherever the tarmac is warmest. Scooters go round it. Buses go round it. It is learning.

name: Gaumata
journalNotes: The cow that blocks the road. Nobody honks. The traffic behind it is in its second generation.

name: Didgeroo
journalNotes: A hollow bamboo that learned to breathe in circles. It came for one season and never stopped the one note.

name: Tulsprout
journalNotes: A sprig of holy basil in a clay pot. It gets watered before anybody in the house gets tea.

name: Tulsiarch
journalNotes: The basil in the courtyard shrine, grown past the roof. The family walks round it every morning. It counts.

name: Conchlet
journalNotes: Hold it to your ear and you hear the sea. Hold it to the sea and it hears you. Found when the tide is out.

name: Shankhorn
journalNotes: The conch blown at dawn, three long notes. The fishermen say the day does not start without it, and nobody has tested this.

name: Omkara
journalNotes: The first sound, the one the others are tuned to. The festival has been one long chord with this note missing.
